plan: A marksman who pokes early on and whose ultimate can wipe a whole grouped-up team.
aSurveiller: Her R (Bullet Time). If you end up in the cone of bullets, get out the side immediately: staying in means dying.
contrer: Don't stay grouped in front of her in fights: spread out to limit her R.
Interrupt her R with a stun or a knock-up: she has to stand still to cast it.
Don't stand behind a nearly dead minion: her Q bounces onto the target right behind.
forces: Huge damage with her R in team fights.
Pokes well early thanks to her Q.
Simple to play, you'll see her very often.
faiblesses: No jump or teleport to escape.
Has to stand still during her R, which makes her vulnerable.
Easy to punish if engaged first.

sorts.P: Deals more damage when she attacks a new target.
sorts.Q: Shot that hits the target then bounces to the enemy right behind.
sorts.W: Gains movement speed, and attack speed on activation.
sorts.E: Rain of bullets that damages and slows in an area.
sorts.R: Barrage of bullets in a cone; she stands still while firing.

momentFort: Dangerous from level 6 with her R, especially in team fights. She loses effectiveness in the late game.
